title: Schedule of Contract Item List Terms by Contract Pricing Agreement Tier
content:
Contract items are the items an agreement carries at fixed net contract unit prices. The figures below govern the contract item list of every Contract Pricing Agreement tier.

Columns, lowest tier to highest: **Account Price Schedule** = Corbett Account Price Schedule; **Volume Discount** = Corbett Volume Discount Agreement; **Category Contract** = Corbett Category Contract; **Net-Price** = Corbett Net-Price Contract; **Cost-Plus** = Corbett Cost-Plus Contract; **Strategic Supply** = Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement.

| Term | Account Price Schedule | Volume Discount | Category Contract | Net-Price | Cost-Plus | Strategic Supply |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smallest number of contract items the agreement carries | 0 | 0 | 25 | 50 | 0 | 100 |
| Largest number of contract items the agreement may carry | 0 | 0 | 100 | 500 | 0 | 2500 |
| Minimum expected annual usage, in selling units, for an item to be added | 0 | 0 | 12 | 12 | 0 | 6 |
| Business days to return a special pricing quote for an item not yet priced on the agreement | 3 | 3 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Calendar days a special pricing quote stays open for acceptance as a contract item | 30 | 30 | 30 | 60 | 60 | 90 |
| Months between scheduled market-basket reviews of contract items; 0 means no scheduled review | 0 | 0 | 12 | 12 | 0 | 6 |
| Calendar days of notice before a contract item removed by Corbett stops carrying its contract price | 0 | 0 | 30 | 30 | 0 | 60 |
| Days a Corbett-approved substitute for a discontinued contract item is billed at the discontinued item's contract price | 0 | 0 | 90 | 90 | 0 | 180 |

### Points of reading

- On the Corbett Account Price Schedule, the Corbett Volume Discount Agreement and the Corbett Cost-Plus Contract the largest item count reads 0.
- The quote figures are two different clocks: the request figure is counted in business days from the request to the quote, and the validity figure in calendar days from the quote date to the acceptance.
- Hypothetical example: with a validity of 30 days, a quote dated on a given day can be accepted on any day up to and including the 30th calendar day after it. (Illustrative only.)
